mapper.sql: id, log_id, tid, cmd_id, sender, receiver, topic, recv_time, process_state, process_errors, processed_time, lock_owner, lock_until, priority, attempts, next_attempt_time, mapped_task_type, mapped_task_id, created_time, updated_time
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO mqtt_inbox (log_id, tid, cmd_id, sender, receiver, topic, recv_time, process_state, priority, attempts, next_attempt_time, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{logId}, #{tid}, #{cmdId}, #{sender}, #{receiver}, #{topic}, #{recvTime}, #{processState}, #{priority}, #{attempts}, #{nextAttemptTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM mqtt_inbox WHERE log_id = #{logId}

SELECT id FROM mqtt_inbox WHERE process_state IN ('RECEIVED','VALIDATED','PARSED','QUEUED') AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until < NOW()) AND next_attempt_time <= NOW() ORDER BY priority ASC, recv_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE mqtt_inbox SET process_state='IN_PROGRESS', lock_owner=#{workerId}, lock_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{ttlSec} SECOND), attempts=attempts+1, updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND process_state IN ('RECEIVED','VALIDATED','PARSED','QUEUED') AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until < NOW()) AND next_attempt_time <= NOW()

UPDATE mqtt_inbox SET process_state='IN_PROGRESS', lock_owner=#{workerId}, lock_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{ttlSec} SECOND), attempts=attempts+1, updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND process_state IN ('RECEIVED','VALIDATED','PARSED','QUEUED') AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until < NOW())
UPDATE mqtt_inbox SET process_state='QUEUED', lock_owner=NULL, lock_until=NULL, updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE mqtt_inbox SET process_state='DONE', processed_time=NOW(), lock_owner=NULL, lock_until=NULL, mapped_task_type=#{mappedTaskType}, mapped_task_id=#{mappedTaskId}, updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE mqtt_inbox SET process_state='REJECTED', process_errors=CONCAT( COALESCE(process_errors,''), CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(process_errors,''))>0 THEN '\n' ELSE '' END, '[', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '] ', #{reason} ), processed_time=NOW(), lock_owner=NULL, lock_until=NULL, updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE mqtt_inbox SET process_state='CANCELLED', process_errors=CONCAT( COALESCE(process_errors,''), CASE WHEN LENGTH(COALESCE(process_errors,''))>0 THEN '\n' ELSE '' END, '[', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '] ', #{reason} ), processed_time=NOW(), lock_owner=NULL, lock_until=NULL, updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE mqtt_inbox SET process_state='QUEUED', lock_owner=NULL, lock_until=NULL, next_attempt_time=NOW(), updated_time=NOW() WHERE process_state='IN_PROGRESS' AND lock_until < NOW()
UPDATE mqtt_inbox SET process_state='QUEUED', lock_owner=NULL, lock_until=NULL, next_attempt_time=DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND), updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM mqtt_inbox WHERE cmd_id = #{cmdId} AND process_state IN ('RECEIVED','VALIDATED','PARSED','QUEUED') AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until < NOW()) AND next_attempt_time <= NOW() ORDER BY priority ASC, recv_time ASC, tid ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id FROM mqtt_inbox WHERE cmd_id = #{cmdId} AND process_state IN ('RECEIVED','VALIDATED','PARSED','QUEUED') AND (lock_until IS NULL OR lock_until < NOW()) ORDER BY priority ASC, recv_time ASC, tid ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1
